machines.name: AlgoVoi Agent Trust Bench
machines.reason: The service issues ATB credentials after its own benchmark and publishes Falcon-1024 keys for offline ATB verification. It exposes no operation accepting an arbitrary AG passport, AGD-1 decision, evidence bundle, or AG URL.

machines.name: Clavis Agent Exchange Hub

closest_operation.body: direct unwrapped A2A Agent Card object
closest_operation.response: valid, score, errors, warnings, issues, skills, spec_version, validated_at

machines.reason: The operation performs local Agent Card field and type checks only. Source proves it does not fetch the endpoint, verify AG signatures, passports, checkpoints, evidence, or trust-extension contents. It is A2A-card conformance, not an Agent Guild trust action, and would create no AG production event.

adjudication: No invocation was made. Clavis remains a safe optional conformance test, but neither machine has a contract that can establish a strict AG conversion.
